# SCI-RTC v0.1/r0.10 to r0.11 clause and equation analysis

Date: 2026-08-21

Status: Implementation-blind supersession map for owner review.  The sealed
r0.10 comparison baseline is commit
`326ec554998a124202d746f435bec8180e875fa1`; it is not edited by this record.

## Exact reopening boundary

R0.11 changes pair-level learning, selection, masks, segmentation, guards,
resets, affected support, and resolved-plan choice when accepted evidence
originates in $r$ or jointly in $x/r$. It does not change r0.10 fixed-stage
conditioned-$x$ filter definitions, donor-factor direction, CAL order,
phase-zero sampling identity, representative occurrence, or the
learn--resolve--apply lifecycle.

## Clause map

| R0.10 locus | R0.11 disposition | R0.11 authority |
| --- | --- | --- |
| DEF-039 optional conditioned-$r$ companion | Preserved and specialized by canonical-pair, evidence, union, common-operator, affine-correction, donor-exception, and descendant identities | DEF-040--051 |
| EQ-036 distinct diagonal blocks $L_x,L_r$ plus covariance | Superseded: paired input/affine state moves to EQ-036; evidence, union, lifecycle, exact identical operator, and covariance receive separate authority | EQ-036--041 |
| REQ-003/108--114 paired companion | Preserved where consistent; exact ordinary-operator equality, pair-level evidence/action, explicit donor exception, naming, and handoff are added | REQ-115--138 |
| PRED-072--077 reopening falsifiers | Preserved; operator equality, union, optical protection, paired shifts, spectral admission, donor influence, and false-action/data-loss cases are added | PRED-078--103 |
| OWNER-084--089 | Preserved except OWNER-087's allowance for distinct ordinary $L_x/L_r$ and any statement that $r$ evidence cannot change $x$ selection/support | OWNER-090--096 |
| R0.10 claim that conditioned-$x$ plan/support is invariant to $r$ | Narrowed: toggling requested output content under a fixed plan remains inert, but accepted $r$ evidence may alter pair-plan selection/support | REQ-122; PRED-072/082--086 |

## Equation map

| Scientific identity | R0.10 | R0.11 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Paired corrected input | Implicit coordinate-specific affine branches in EQ-036 | Explicit paired input and independent affine state in EQ-036 |
| Evidence | Generic learned evidence in EQ-028 | $E_x,E_r,E_{xr}$ minimum inventory in EQ-037 |
| Hard support | Pair-coherent prose | Cause-preserving set union in EQ-038 |
| Pair plan | Generic Learn--Resolve--Apply in EQ-028 | Pair-specific Resolve/Apply and immutability in EQ-039 |
| Fixed-state response | `diag(L_x,L_r)` in EQ-036 | Exact `I_2 tensor L_Pi` in EQ-040 |
| Joint covariance | Distinct-block propagation in EQ-036 | Common-operator propagation with retained cross block in EQ-041 |
| Data-dependent $r$ effect on $x$ | Excluded by the bounded r0.10 reopening | Permitted only through evidence to Resolve to pair plan to $y_x$; fixed numerical cross branch remains zero |

## Preserved exclusions

No $x\leftrightarrow r$ numerical mixing, automatic $r\rightarrow x$
subtraction, $r$ calibration, cross-coordinate donor, inferred $r$ repair,
default joint-$r$ activation, PTC policy, SCI-VAL aggregation, implementation
claim, validation result, performance claim, science qualification, or
production claim is introduced.
